subject: expression: provide `BuildExprWithAst` to build expression without planner context (#50464)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for `pkg/expression/expression.go` and `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go` plus wiring in `pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go` and added tests. Change introduces `expression.BuildExprWithAst` (with options for input schema/names, source table, and cast-to-array gating) implemented via a refactor that lets `expressionRewriter` operate without a PlanBuilder context, while explicitly rejecting planner-only AST nodes (subqueries/aggregates/window/etc.). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/data consistency/session behavior within the touched expression/planner codepaths. Later history on `upstream/master` shows subsequent refactors around this API but no indication of a remaining Blocker/High issue specific to this commit.
